name: Hyde Park Saturday Hunt
location: Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, London

checkpoints.name: Stone fountain
checkpoints.clue: Where a princess is remembered by water that never runs in a straight line.

checkpoints.name: Boy who never grew up
checkpoints.clue: He promised never to grow old; find him by the long water.

checkpoints.name: Speakers' Corner
checkpoints.clue: Stand on a soapbox where anyone may have their say. Open for the last hour only.
